items.title: Dozens of former Australian Rules footballers diagnosed with CTE
items.description: Australian Rules footballers who never played in the game's premier league are being diagnosed with CTE, revealing that the brain trauma crisis is striking all levels of the game.

items.title: 'It's shocking': ASIC says too many Australians' retirement savings are being wiped out
items.description: The corporate watchdog is concerned that super trustees that manage Australians' retirement savings have a lack of safeguards in place.

items.title: Last week was a turning point inside the Liberal party
items.description: While Angus Taylor grapples with the Coalition's dilemma of how to keep the centre while diverting voters away from Pauline Hanson's party, Andrew Hastie has been talking tough on One Nation.

items.title: The Gulf will 'not go back to where it was' after the Iran war
items.description: Before a flare-up in fighting over the weekend, the interim deal between the United States and Iran was giving the region something it badly needs, analysts say.

items.title: Royal commission spotlight falls on 'unregulated cesspool of disinformation'
items.description: The "cesspool" of anti-Jewish material on social media is set to be examined when the antisemitism royal commission resumes this week.

items.title: Two things this week gave clues about the global future
items.description: Two things happened last week that give us a much clearer picture of what the world is going to be like from now on.

items.title: Live: Canada scores stunning injury time winner to down South Africa
items.description: World Cup co-host Canada beats South Africa to progress into the last 16 thanks to a last-gasp strike from Stephen Eustaquio in Los Angeles. Follow live.

items.title: Baby, young boys pulled alive from Venezuela earthquake rubble
items.description: The three children are among at least 33 people rescued during a weekend multinational operation that continued searching for survivors, while thousands remained unaccounted-for.

items.title: Live: Labor welcomes 'modest' poll turnaround as One Nation support drops
items.description: Labor's Tanya Plibersek has welcomed a modest improvement in a pair of opinion polls that suggest support for One Nation has dropped. Follow live.

items.title: New laws aim to make it harder to launder ill-gotten gains through property
items.description: Anti-money laundering laws mean that for the first time, real estate agents, lawyers, accountants and others must report suspicious transactions.

items.title: Live: Maroons reveal final Origin line-up after Blues' bombshell
items.description: After NSW locked in its squad for State of Origin III, Billy Slater is announcing his line-up for the decider at Lang Park. Follow live.

items.title: As Ben Stokes retires, a former captain warns 'he won't be the last'
items.description: England captain Ben Stokes will retire from international cricket after the third Test against New Zealand, the team has said.

items.title: Australia and Vanuatu set to sign strategic pact after months of negotiations
items.description: Vanuatu's Prime Minister Jotham Napat and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese are set to ink the Nakamal Agreement, almost 10 months after Mr Napat pulled out of a planned signing ceremony in Port Vila, citing concerns around sovereignty.

items.title: Thai teenager's father 'deeply saddened' as Australian charged with murder
items.description: The family of a 17-year-old girl in Thailand speak of their grief as an Australian man is charged with her murder.

items.title: Do you qualify for three hours of free electricity? Here's how it works
items.description: Under the federal government's Solar Sharer scheme, some Australian households will be able to access three hours of free electricity a day. Here's how you can make the most of it.

items.title: History quiz: How much do you know about Eminem, Austen and elite chess?
items.description: This week was a big one in times gone by. From this decade to the 17th century, put your history knowledge to the test.

items.title: Race Around The World recap: Catch this week's films
items.description: From survival vaults in Norway to a pianist in Pisa, catch up on the films from week four of Race Around The World.

items.title: Skydiving plane crashes in France, killing all 11 people on board
items.description: A small aircraft carrying skydivers has crashed in eastern France, killing all 11 people on board, local authorities say.

items.title: Live: Renewed Gulf hostilities put markets on edge, ASX poised for marginal gain
items.description: Wall Street was weighed down by another bout of selling in the tech sector. The ASX is priced to edged higher despite renewed hostilities in the Gulf

items.title: Report finds 'extensive' coal and gas presence in schools and children's sport
items.description: Santos, BHP, Woodside and others have an "extensive presence" in childhood settings through more than 260 programs, a new report identifies, as senators say classroom programs and lessons written by the industry should be examined through a senate inquiry.

items.title: Trump allies seek largest reduction in Black representation ever
items.description: States in America's South are scrambling to draw up new electoral maps that would eliminate majority-Black electorates.

items.title: Lawyers under pressure as court backlog hits 'crisis point'
items.description: Routine cases are dragging through Tasmanian courts for years as senior lawyers lament the "crisis" engulfing the state's criminal justice system.

items.title: Ageing 'Nashos' call for priority as all veterans get equal access to health benefits
items.description: All Australian veterans will soon have access to claim compensation for health issues, fulfilling a royal commission recommendation, but those conscripted during the Vietnam War say their advanced age means their claims should receive priority.

items.title: New NT police public safety officers 'fully trained' in carrying guns
items.description: The Northern Territory Police Force has moved to reassure Territorians that new, armed public safety officers due to hit the beat from today are fully trained to carry guns.

items.title: Qld government dumps plan to turn gold mine into pumped hydro
items.description: A $6 billion dollar project to rehabilitate a gold mine and turn it into a pumped hydro power station has been dumped by the Queensland government.
